description: Upload a forensic evidence file to a case and create a working copy. A spreadsheet named 'Access_Logs_2025.xlsx' is located in your Documents folder. You must: 1. Navigate to the existing complaint case 'Internal Audit - Unauthorized Access'. 2. Upload the 'Access_Logs_2025.xlsx' file to the case's Documents section (root folder). 3. Create a duplicate/copy of this file within the same folder. 4. Rename the copy to exactly 'Access_Logs_Working_Copy.xlsx'. 5. Ensure the original file remains unmodified.
